target.title: feat(android): bind app chat to a dedicated session
target.body:
Related: #45854

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where Android app chat could reuse the gateway's generic main session context after pairing, so app-originated chat history and follow-up requests were not cleanly isolated from other OpenClaw surfaces connected to the same agent.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Android app now derives a stable `openclaw-app-*` session key for each connected gateway endpoint, explicitly creates that app session after a successful operator connection, and binds chat/history/talk mode to that key before app chat traffic resumes.

The app session create request intentionally omits parent-session and emit-hook fields, so the Android app session is independent rather than a child of another surface. The proof workflow is manual-only behind `workflow_dispatch` + `include_android`, so normal push/PR CI does not run the emulator media capture by default.

## User Impact

Android app users get a dedicated OpenClaw App session per gateway connection. Reconnects and gateway switches keep app chat scoped to the Android app's session instead of blending into the agent's default `main` chat or other connected surfaces.

## Evidence

GitHub Actions on `snowzlmbot/openclaw`, exact head SHA `838fa5dde4aec11e1f575c6092f95127ea81959f`:

- Full CI run passed: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/28907001143
- Android app session media proof job passed: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/28907001143/job/85758758496
- Media/log artifact: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/28907001143/artifacts/8154958242

The artifact contains:

- `openclaw-app-session-proof.mp4` and `openclaw-app-session-proof.png` from a real Android emulator run.
- `session-create.json` showing the app created `agent:main:openclaw-app-1f52fae09049` with label `OpenClaw App · Proof Pixel`.
- `gateway-events.jsonl` showing `sessions.create` followed by `chat.history` using the same app session key.
- `logcat-tail.txt` and the debug APK used for the emulator proof.

Relevant captured `sessions.create` payload:

```json
{
  "method": "sessions.create",
  "key": "agent:main:openclaw-app-1f52fae09049",
  "label": "OpenClaw App · Proof Pixel",
  "agentId": "main",
  "hasParentSessionKey": false,
  "hasEmitCommandHooks": false
}
```

Local lightweight checks run before pushing:

- `git diff --check`
- `ruby -e "require 'yaml'; YAML.load_file('.github/workflows/ci.yml', aliases: true); puts 'ci yaml ok'"`
- `pnpm native:i18n:check`

## Evidence Source Map

- Dedicated Android app session key: `session-create.json` from the media proof artifact.
- App chat binding to the dedicated session: `gateway-events.jsonl` shows `chat.history` with the same `agent:main:openclaw-app-*` key.
- No child-session coupling: `session-create.json` records `hasParentSessionKey: false` and `hasEmitCommandHooks: false`.
- Real UI/media evidence: emulator screenshot and MP4 in the uploaded artifact.
- CI coverage: successful run `28907001143` at the exact PR head SHA.

## Risk

- Low runtime risk: the session key is derived from the gateway endpoint/device identity and remains stable across reconnects.
- The change touches Android session binding and chat history routing; tests cover key generation and chat controller session policy.
- The emulator proof job is manual-only and pinned to full action SHAs.

## Rollback

Revert this PR to return Android chat to the previous gateway main-session behavior and remove the manual emulator proof job.

## Docs Updated

- `apps/android/README.md` documents the dedicated `OpenClaw App · <device>` session behavior.
- `apps/.i18n/native-source.json` was synced after Android source changes.
